tests.title: Planted sensor jump detected
tests.case: 200 trials: a jump (factor 1.5 to 3, up or down) in one witness of a random fire region or a random single cell from a random month in 2012-2021, planted in the in-memory aggregated table
tests.criterion: Flagged (WITNESS_DISAGREEMENT or a disagreement scale of at least 1.5) in the jump month or the two after in at least 90% of trials, and false flags in under 5% of unplanted series
tests.threshold: detection >= 90% and false flags < 5% (locked at G1, D-028)
tests.notes: Readings of the plan [ASSUMPTION], task prompt section 15 items 1 to 5. False flag = the same rule on the unplanted twin of each trial (same three months): the rate under pure chance for two witnesses is about 13% over three months. See docs/validation/T-024-results.md.

tests.threshold: detection >= 90% and false flags < 5%
tests.notes: Supplementary reading; the official entry is B2.

tests.notes: Supplementary: the plan does not say what a false flag per series means; the status here applies the 5% threshold to the monthly union-rule rate.

tests.case: Fire-region-months 2018-01 to 2021-12, both converted estimates >= 5 Aqua-equivalent cell-days (630 units)
tests.criterion: Share of region-months where converted S-NPP and converted NOAA-20 agree within the combined 90% intervals

tests.notes: Agreement = the difference within 1.645 x sqrt(sd_S^2 + sd_N^2) [ASSUMPTION 6]. The whole window is IN sample for NOAA-20 (calibration 2018-04 to 2021-12) and out of sample for S-NPP; no month is out of sample for both: see C1-OUT-OF-SAMPLE-2022-2024.

tests.title: Uncertainty honest (coverage), pooled over all fire regions
tests.case: Fire-region-months 2017-2021, Aqua against converted S-NPP, day/night units with at least 20 Aqua cell-days
tests.criterion: Holdout 2017-2021: share of actual Aqua values inside the predicted 90% intervals (pooled over all fire-region day/night units)
tests.threshold: between 80% and 97% (locked at G1, D-028)
tests.notes: Pooled reading of the criterion [ASSUMPTION]. Not a clean out-of-sample test: phi and kappa were fitted on fit-period months and the NOAA-20 pair overlaps these months on the Aqua side. No widening factor applied (Lead decision). The 50% interval covers less than 50%: the intervals are slightly too narrow in the middle. Known limits in D1-NIGHT and D1-REGIONS-EACH (risk S16).

tests.title: Generalization (leave one fire region out)
tests.case: 14 GFED fire regions, 2017-2021 Aqua series predicted from S-NPP converted with a calibration fitted without the region
tests.criterion: Our method beats the naive raw merge (lower median absolute log error, day and night) in at least 11 of 14 regions; all regions reported
tests.threshold: >= 11 of 14 regions (locked at G1, D-028)
tests.notes: S-NPP fit 2012-01 to 2016-12 only; a region left out is converted with the global ratio of the fit without it. See docs/validation/T-025-results.md.

tests.criterion: Conclusions unchanged: every A1 case status, the A1 family status, both B1 statuses and every peak-window verdict of C1-C6 equal in the filtered and unfiltered runs
tests.threshold: S1 (VALIDATION_PLAN section 3): conclusions unchanged, any change reported; rule fixed in docs/task-prompts/T-025b-s1-confidence.md section 9

tests.title: Sensitivity (A1 and B1 without the confidence filter, and with the Aqua-measured baseline)
tests.criterion: Conclusions unchanged (report any that change)
tests.threshold: pre-registered at G1
tests.notes: Both halves ran: S1-BASELINE FAIL (T-025) and S1-CONFIDENCE-FILTER PASS (T-025b). Overall by the rule: FAIL if either half FAILs, PASS if both PASS [ASSUMPTION, flagged for the Lead]. S1-CONFIDENCE-FILTER PASS means the conclusions do not depend on the filter, not that A1 passes (A1 is FAIL with and without it).
